scope: active population selection, role-duration and promotion-date validity, reporting-span link integrity, directed graph cycles, missing observations, threshold semantics, aggregate API redaction, current glossary and legacy structural compatibility
confirmed_behavior: Structural construction copies the active population and reports role-duration, promotion-duration, date-parse and reporting-link coverage without turning missing observations into zero.

Negative or impossible role durations remain unavailable; future hire dates, promotion dates before hire, promotion dates after an explicit snapshot, and materially mismatched promotion durations are excluded and counted.

Reporting spans use only exact current EmployeeID-to-ManagerID links; missing, self, dangling and directed-cycle links are excluded and disclosed. Cyclic links never contribute to direct-report counts.

Span boundaries are explicit: optimal bounds are inclusive, warning_threshold is the first overloaded span, and critical_threshold is the first critical span. The numeric BurnoutRiskScore proxy is no longer emitted.

Canonical structural analysis and governed API routes expose aggregate observations only, redact employee and manager records, retain deprecated individual routes as blocked, and preserve non-burnout, non-promotion-readiness and non-causal-health semantics.
Current glossary wording and legacy schema compatibility no longer describe impossible stagnation values or require a non-null burnout score.
interpretation_boundary: Structural outputs describe recorded organization structure and current-state durations. They are screening observations only and do not measure burnout, wellbeing, manager effectiveness, promotion readiness, discrimination, collaboration, team health or causal organizational effects.
remaining_scientific_limits: An explicit SnapshotDate is required for future-date and elapsed-time reconciliation; a cross-sectional file without an as-of date cannot support those checks.

Role-duration and years-since-promotion fields remain source-defined measurements; their business definitions, rounding tolerance and relationship to actual role changes require owner and HRIS validation.
Span thresholds are configuration prompts, not empirically validated workload or wellbeing cutoffs; reporting lines do not establish collaboration or organizational health.
Promotion comparisons remain unadjusted observational group comparisons without multiplicity correction, causal identification, or a validated promotion-readiness outcome.
Privacy, access control, retention, worker consultation and production-owner acceptance remain required before consequential use.

blocked_findings: Shared engine-audit inventory/hash gate is stale for existing uncommitted changes and is explicitly out of scope for this cycle.
Other uncommitted agent lanes currently fail search permission and sentiment shape expectations; no structural test failed.

release_gate: GO for a bounded local descriptive structural pilot only. NO-GO for public launch or any burnout, promotion-readiness, discrimination, collaboration, team-health or causal organizational claim until scientific validation, shared audit reconciliation, independent review and production governance are complete.
